questions.q: Where do you open the OneLake catalog in Microsoft Fabric?
options: From the OneLake catalog icon in the Fabric navigation pane
Only from the Admin portal
Only from inside a workspace's settings menu
From a separate standalone application outside Fabric
questions.explain: The OneLake catalog is opened from its own icon in the Fabric left navigation pane, and the same catalog is also embedded in Teams, Excel, and Copilot Studio.

questions.q: What are the OneLake catalog's three tabs?
options: Explore, Govern, and Secure
Browse, Admin, and Audit
Search, Catalog, and Lineage
Items, Workspaces, and Domains
questions.explain: The catalog is organized into Explore (find and browse items), Govern (governance status and recommended actions), and Secure (workspace and OneLake security roles).

questions.q: Why does the Explore tab sometimes list items a user doesn't yet have access to?
options: Discoverable semantic models (and some DLP-restricted reports) are shown deliberately, so users can find them and request access
It's a bug Microsoft hasn't fixed yet
Fabric shows every item in every tenant to every user by default
Only workspace admins ever see items they lack access to
questions.explain: Semantic models their owner made discoverable, and reports whose semantic model is restricted by a DLP policy, are listed on purpose so users can see they exist and request access.

questions.q: What does selecting a domain in the OneLake catalog's domain selector do?
options: Scopes the Explore item list and the Govern tab's insights to just that domain or subdomain
Deletes all items outside that domain
Grants the user admin rights over that domain
Has no effect unless the user is a Fabric administrator
questions.explain: If an organization has defined domains, the selector scopes both the Explore item list and the Govern tab's governance insights and recommended actions to the chosen domain or subdomain, and the choice persists across sessions.

questions.q: Which tab of the item detail pane shows an item's upstream and downstream relationships?
options: Lineage
Overview
Monitor
Permissions
questions.explain: The Lineage tab shows the item's upstream and downstream relationships as a list or graph; Overview covers description/ownership, Monitor covers refresh history, and Permissions covers access.
